title: Multiple workshops restricted to one worker limited parallel work
claim: Two craft workshops were restricted to the same worker, who was also the manager. An idle second workshop did not mean other workers could use it. Opening the utility workshop to eligible workers while retaining a master workshop was followed by parallel craft production.
reproduction: Inspect each workshop's permitted workers, actual jobs, relevant labors and manager-order validation. Where appropriate, separate utility throughput from specialist quality, then verify simultaneous jobs rather than merely counting queued orders.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
Both workshop profiles initially listed the same single permitted worker.
After the utility profile was opened, native snapshots showed two MakeCrafts jobs running concurrently.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. Other production changes occurred during the session; this is not an isolated throughput benchmark or proof of the cause of every management delay. Eligible labor and reachable materials still matter.
